system.description:
While fighters focus on specializing in specific fighting styles, adepts forgo weapons altogether, and berserkers tend to pick a big weapon to pulverize their foes with, as a ranger you have to be more fluid with your weapon choices and change your style based on the environment and situation. You gain the following benefits when using weapons with the following traits.

Ranged or Thrown

Cut your ranged weapon’s long range in half. Add that value to your ranged weapon’s normal range.

Dual-Wielding

When you deal damage with your off-hand attacks using a dual-wielding weapon, if the weapon rolls damage less than your Strength or Dexterity ability modifier, whichever is higher, you deal damage equal to your modifier, instead.

Versatile

Versatile weapons gain the vicious weapon trait when you wield them.
